'''Artoo''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] who belonged to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jhensara]]. Artoo was one of three droids on the ship alongside [[Arthree (Jhensara)|Arthree]] and [[Arfive (Jhensara)|Arfive]].
